name: policy-untrack-of-a-strict-path-is-refused
description: #261: POST /policy/untrack refuses, with the typed reason untrack_strict_path and HTTP 409, an entry that covers a path the live policy holds in strict mode (here the strict glob itself, beside a valid non-strict entry), naming the strict pattern; the whole request writes nothing. Before, the untrack reloaded the policy and the strict path dropped to the untracked fast path, where a CAS commit is accepted at any expected_version (a silent lost update). The error text is prose for the CLI and is not pinned; clients classify by reason. Both backends: the plugin's Node coordinator refuses the same way (cohexa-ai/agent-coherence-plugin#177).
